Containers.Name: unMotion
Containers.Overview: Migrate libvirt virtual machines between paired Unraid hosts with storage-aware preflight, transfer, cutover, and recovery handling.
Containers.Description: unMotion migrates libvirt virtual machines between paired Unraid hosts. It supports storage-aware cold moves and warm moves with a final powered-off cutover, while preserving migration safety checks and resumable ZFS receive state.
